nodes.statement: However, inspired by this interpretation, one has provided a systematic strategy to improve the LP-hierarchy by doing a much less brutal simplification. That is, one now imposes on the same nonnegative polynomial to be an SOS polynomial whose degree k is fixed in advance and parametrizes the whole hierarchy.
